name: Standard Gaussian Rendering with SH-to-RGB Conversion
definition: The standard rendering function that rasterizes Gaussians and then converts Spherical Harmonics (SH) coefficients to RGB colors in Python post-rasterization.
summary: Standard Gaussian Rendering with SH-to-RGB Conversion computes RGB colors from spherical harmonics in Python before rasterization, allowing the rasterizer to use simpler inputs while deferring directional color evaluation to the host code.
